questions.question: The sandpit is 6 m long and 4 m wide. Find its perimeter and its area.
questions.expected_answer: The perimeter is 2 × 10 = 20 m, because the length and width add to 10 m. The area is 6 × 4 = 24 square metres.

questions.question: Describe the climbing frame, a square-based pyramid, by its faces, vertices and edges.
questions.expected_answer: It has 5 faces, which are 1 square and 4 triangles. It has 5 vertices, 4 at the base and 1 at the apex, and 8 edges, 4 around the base and 4 up to the apex.

questions.question: Explain why regular hexagon pavers tessellate.
questions.expected_answer: Three regular hexagons meet at each point, and their three angles fill a full revolution exactly, so there are no gaps and no overlaps.
